description: This file is a controller module for handling blockchain-related HTTP requests. It exports a function 'handleGetDigitalId' which processes incoming requests to retrieve a digital tourist ID and uses an external service 'getDigitalTouristId' to fetch data.

methods.name: handleGetDigitalId(req, res, next)
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to retrieve digital tourist ID, calls external service 'getDigitalTouristId', and sends the response as JSON.
